title: Resume
description: Only what the rest of the repo does not already carry. Proof story titles and summaries come from data/proof, the skill terms from data/skills.json, and the name and title from data/identity.json, so one edit moves the resume and the site together. An empty section renders as nothing.

summary.description: Two or three sentences in his voice. Empty until he writes it, and the renderer falls back to the identity hero.

lead_proof.description: Proof story ids from data/proof, in the order they should read.

skill_areas.description: Areas from data/skills.json, in the order they should read. An area with no terms is skipped.
